notes.title: Update EA 1.2
notes.content:
[h2]Hello![/h2]
This week update contains:

[h3]Items[/h3]
- Added the function to duplicate items at the Workshop
- Added Propeler item
- Decreased the crafting time from 5 to 3 sec

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
- Fixed the pause menu flicker
- Fixed loading game after creating a new one and going back to the main menu

[h3]Others[/h3]
- Added fancy icons to buttons
- Bunch of new sounds for different actions
- Added panel of controls under the options menu
- Added tutorial and more Drill dialog textes
- Redone the terrain generator
- Some graphical improvements including a new Workshop

notes.title: Update EA 1.1
notes.content:
[h1]Hello![/h1]
I will first start with some personal insights. I'm sorry I left this project out for a very long time. I recently fully returned to making games after finishing university and working a full time job. In the past years I had little time for personal projects and not a lot of programing knowledge either. From now on I want to change that.

This week I released some updates for MDR through which I want to make it playable and fun. I'm also looking for feedback and ideas from the community to improve the game. 

[h2]Available in this update:[/h2]
[h3]Mobs[/h3]
- Added 3 mobs. They spawn in different stages of drilling - first levels of dirt, underwater, caves.
- Each mob drops a specific key that you can use later on to open treasures.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30312246/4beab61d7a1934e21d7f9a587541fe178244a441.png[/img]

[h3]Story[/h3]
- Compared to classic MineDrill, this game has a story which you will have to find out on your own.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30312246/411ae98ad92283d7560efd8273474e9ce3097013.png[/img]

[h3]Items and crafting[/h3]
- More than 30 items used for crafting upgrades, mods, rocket parts. More will be added in the future updates.
- 10 ores to drill.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30312246/4616db89ca81f5aabadfa65cbea730c158e22496.png[/img]

[h3]Mods[/h3]
- The drill has 4 base components which can be upgraded and 3 more mods.
- The most important mod is the Laser Gun without which you can't defend yourself.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30312246/e52825d5027b9ee8f1a99251ba4f9db08bfbfab6.png[/img]

[h3]Powerups[/h3]
- 4 powerups that help movement, drilling and lighting dark zones.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30312246/9d5653ccc0a37c3945b1c86ffe7f4a9f50890ee7.png[/img]

[h2]Upcoming next weeks:[/h2]
- Full controller support. Currently is partial.
- More sounds.
- Steam achievements.
- Missions an XP system for unlocking things.

More things will be added depending on feedback after the necessary fixings.
